summary: Implemented a shared frozen model contract for tagging, copy-or-update, and JSON serialization, then moved the public container and IR layers onto it with passing tests.
key_findings: Added `src/autofdtd/core/models.py` with `AutoFDTDModel`, `TaggedModel`, and `json_ready()` as the common contract for Phase 1 models.
`Structure`, `Scene`, `Simulation`, and all IR models now inherit shared serialization and `copy_update()` behavior instead of duplicating helpers in subsystem-local base classes.
Exported the shared base types through `autofdtd.core`, `autofdtd.api`, and package root so later feature families can depend on one stable model surface.
Extended tests to cover generic tag lookup, immutable copy/update behavior, and shared helper usage across both API and IR layers.
Updated working memory and README to record the decision that shared model behavior must live in `autofdtd.core.models`.

artifacts.description: New shared base-model module with frozen model config, tag access, copy/update helper, JSON serialization, and generic JSON-normalization utility.
Public container models switched to the shared tagged base contract.
IR models switched to the shared tagged base and common JSON helper.
Added coverage for shared model helpers and container tag behavior.
Added coverage for IR copy/update behavior on the shared model contract.
Recorded the new shared-model decision and reusable facts for later tasks.

follow_up_notes: Verified with `python -m pytest` from `/workspace/autofdtd`; all 24 tests passed.
